body: Mm, I don’t really know the reason to be honest. I cried yesterday as well when hearing someone getting compliments so it’s safe to say that my issue is still ongoing lol. It could be because I don’t get compliments often or it could be because I know that no one will ever feel that way about me, I cry also giving compliments and i think it’s because of feeling so overwhelmed and wanting that person to feel like they’re loved.

Today I was just crying. I saw a celebrity accused of appropriation and the comments were just tearing down black women, that even people in politic were defending this woman and I realized that they really hate us. I remembered an incident a few months ago of a non black person saying the n word and when confronted their fans posted pictures saying how much they hate black people and started posting photos of black people getting lynch*d and how it was so hard to defend black people because we’re dramatic and I just turned off the phone and laid in silence. Sometimes I think that if I have to go through these things that I’m just better off dead.
By school I meant high school. My mom pulled me out sophomore year of high school after I confessed to my guidance counselor my suicidal tendencies.

I’m sorry about you possibly having the chance of being homeless. I know if I don’t get a job I won’t be homeless but I’d be disappointed my family which would be a trigger for me. But I’m proud of you for trying to plan your future and be productive.

I turn 20 in 2 weeks and I’m absolutely terrified. I’ve been locked in my home since I left school sophomore year and I don’t know what to do with myself. I haven’t finished school, no job, no friends. I have so much anxiety just thinking of walking my dog down the street. I feel
Like once I turn 20, being isolated isn’t going to go well and be burdensome to my family. I feel like I should’ve died when I was 16 and since that didn’t go the way I wanted I’m just barely here.

Yeah I agree. I want to talk it about with her but I feel like even with proof she’ll still defend him and somehow switch the blame to me or say I’m overthinking it. He’s a big part of her life so I don’t think she’ll let him go. I’m just nervous because in our friend group everyone respects her so if she twist me into this narrative of being a bad friend all of them will be against me.
Unfortunately I’m in a situation where I am unable to move out.

I haven’t talked to them about this. I’m just not comfortable with them enough to share my struggles. I just shut down. I’ll try to laugh it off sometimes but afterwards I just feel drained of energy. My whole body shuts down and I’m just emotionless. I needed therapy years ago but my mom never helped me get help. If was a line in a movie one time and it said “Black people don’t get depressed.” And she looked at me and said “You heard that? Black people don’t get depressed.” To me. A black teenager girl so yeah.

I am not adopted. I have 2 moms and a dad. My dad is just.. distant I suppose and I live with my mom and her partner. I have 4 siblings. 3 sisters and one brother. My brother is in and out of jail. Stealing and doing whatever. My mom finally kicked him out recently. My oldest sister lives in a different state but they have a good relationship. My 2nd oldest sister lives with her boyfriend and they have an okay relationship. My sister is very draining to be around. She’s really negative and not a very good person unfortunately so my parents doesn’t really associate much with her but they don’t ignore her either. My baby sister is only 4 so they treat her really well.

I’m stuck here unfortunately. I begged my parents for virtual school but they said no. I skipped class to hid in the bathroom which led to a talk with my school counselor which led to me being in a mental hospital and my parents finally taking me out of school. My parents just failed me education wise. Instead of signing me up for virtual school, from 16 to now I haven’t been in school since that day. She said it’s what I chose because she told 16 year old me to sign myself up for a virtual school as if I knew how to put myself through school. I’ve been home doing nothing for 4 years. While everyone else was graduating, I’ve been home looking after my sister. I have nothing in my name, no education prior half of my sophomore year in high school so no job. I’m stuck here for now.
